motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills the frame: him, the sack, the NEIGHBOUR, the swatter or the camera; never a second where only the mouth moves; shot size keeps changing
camera_moves: wide at 0.0, macro on his face by 7.9, wide again at 9.6; moves on 2.1, 4.5, 7.9 only
lens_passes: something sweeps past the lens at 0.0, 2.1, 5.85, 7.3, 9.3
character: HERO: lanky stubbly shift-worker mosquito, heavy-lidded eyes, long proboscis, work shirt
cast: NEIGHBOUR: a second mosquito with an identical sack, backlit, crosses at the lens in 0.3 s at 5.85; Two more scatter large in front at 7.3. none speak
props: SACK: glossy ruby-red ball-sack on straps with a small brass spout, keeps its round shape, ripples on impact and rounds back. MIC: shotgun mic in grey foam on a boom, no hand. GLASS: one tall empty glass at the left. SWATTER: a flat green fly swatter on a nail on the post behind him from the first frame, out of focus until 9.3
prop_continuity: sack on his back 0.0-2.1, on the table from 2.1 to the end; glass empty 0.0-4.5, full 4.5-6.0, empty from 6.0
setting: blazing midday sun overhead: a wooden terrace table, boards bleached white, crisp hard black shadows, bright sunlit background, a sun glint on the glass

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: weary deadpan male chest voice near 130 Hz, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one pause only, 7.3-7.9; the 4.5 and 5.85 lines run together with no breath; endings voiced, nothing after 9.3
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over

timeline.a: silent. The mic rams in point blank; he recoils whole-body, the sack swings forward and folds his hind legs
he turns and walks at the lens until his head fills the frame; the sack swings full circle and slams his back
silent. He swings the sack past the lens and drops it on the table, BAM: it ripples and rounds back, the glass jumps. HIS BACK IS BARE
both front legs sweep one arc from frame edge to frame edge, dust kicking up off the boards behind the sweep
silent. He tips the sack by its spout over the glass: a thick ruby stream, same red as the sack, fills it to the brim
he hoists the full glass at the lens with both front legs and drains it in one long pull, the glass filling the frame
same sentence, no breath. He thumps the empty glass down and drags a foreleg slowly across his whole face, wiping it, dead tired
silent, the only pause. The flat shadow of the swatter sweeps across the sunlit table and is gone; two mosquitoes scatter large in front; he ducks only after it passed
macro on his face, deadpan into the lens; he rises and drops through the whole tall frame on his wings
silent. The green swatter drops in from the top of the frame and slams the boards flat, dust bursting out sideways
silent. The swatter lifts away: bare clean boards, the sack still on the table, the glass rocking, the mic swaying empty

must_appear: the ruby stream from the spout at 3.9, the full glass at 4.5, the NEIGHBOUR at 5.85, two mosquitoes at 7.3, the swatter at 9.3, the sack still there at 9.6
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dark scene, moody lighting, low key, lamplight, blood, gore, a puddle or spill on the table, the sack bursting, a crushed insect under the swatter, a human hand or body in frame, a second copy of the HERO, a third sack on him, two glasses or mics, floating props, cuts, subtitles, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, drawn-out delivery, swallowed endings
